subject: The secret confession that changed everything
preview_text: She almost deleted the app. Then she discovered the one feature that revealed the truth she'd been ignoring for months.
body_paragraphs: I got an email last week that made me stop everything. A user named Sarah wrote to me. She said she'd downloaded the app, scanned one conversation, saw a few yellow flags, and thought 'maybe I'm just being paranoid.' She was about to delete it. But something made her open it one more time.

She decided to use the Pattern Detection feature. She uploaded screenshots from the last three months. Not just the bad moments, but the sweet ones too. The 'I miss you' texts right after a fight. The promises that always came after she'd been upset. The app connected dots she couldn't see because she was in the middle of the painting. It showed her a cycle: criticism, withdrawal, love bombing, repeat. A toxicity score that started at 30% and quietly climbed to 85%. She wasn't paranoid. She was protecting herself.

That feature exists because of stories like Sarah's. Because one conversation is a snapshot, but patterns are the movie. The Relationship Health Dashboard isn't just a score—it's a timeline of behavior. It shows you if things are getting better or quietly worse. It separates 'one bad day' from 'a pattern of bad days.'

Open the app. Go to the dashboard. Upload just 2-3 conversations from different weeks. Let it show you the timeline, not just the snapshot. Sometimes clarity isn't a lightning bolt. It's a pattern finally coming into focus. P.S. Sarah wrote me yesterday. She said 'Thank you for showing me the movie when I was only looking at the poster.'
